author: A pamphlet nailed to a Windhelm door
pages:
#Brothers and Sisters

Who stood at the Red Ring when the elves came for the Imperial City? Nords. Who bled for the Empire in every war for two hundred years? Nords.

And when the war was done, what did the Empire give us? A treaty that outlaws Talos, the god who was born a man of Skyrim.

#Why We Fight

We fight because a people who cannot worship their own gods are not free. We fight because the Thalmor walk our roads with lists of names. We fight because the Empire has forgotten who carried it.

Join us in Windhelm. Bring your axe. Bring your sons, if they are old enough. Skyrim will remember.
